---
name: Reproducible regression
about: Report a source or workflow failure with sanitized evidence
---

## Commit and environment

Commit SHA, Node/pnpm version, OS/browser and isolated local/staging context.
Do not include credentials or account/customer details.

## Reproduction

Exact command or numbered steps using synthetic data; expected and actual
behavior; repeatability and cleanup.

## Evidence and impact

Sanitized error/screenshot, affected workflow, and checks already performed.
For a suspected secret exposure or vulnerability follow SECURITY.md privately.
